q: Do printer toner cartridges count in our carbon footprint?
title: Printer toner cartridges: Scope 3
short: Yes, as purchased goods in Scope 3 Category 1, usually counted by number of cartridges and a factor per cartridge or per kg. Remanufactured cartridges carry a lower figure. Printing electricity is in your Scope 2 already.

ul: Cartridges bought per year, from invoices.
Weight or a per-cartridge factor with its source.

p: Small for most offices. Paper and IT hardware usually matter more.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
